Definition
[Minimizing geodesic ray]

Source: morgan-tian ↗ def:geodesic

A unit-speed geodesic ray $\lambda \colon [0,\infty )\to M$ is minimizing if \[ d(\lambda (s),\lambda (t))=|s-t|\qquad (s,t\ge 0). \] Equivalently, every compact subarc realizes the distance between its endpoints. The metric identity is also used as the definition in a metric space.
